correctness.rationale: For all integer k>=1, degree ell>=0, and reduced rational c=p/q in (-1,1) with q even, Funk--Hecke gives an exact cap eigenvalue. An explicit Gegenbauer coefficient identity proves the leading c^m term has unique least 2-adic valuation. A finite polynomial integral proves the same for the cap mass. Combining rational valuations yields -ell*v2(q)-v2((ell+2k-1)!/(2k-2)!), including ell=0; thus no zero eigenvalues. Harmonic completeness proves injectivity and bounded indicator kernel proves Hilbert--Schmidt compactness. Exact arithmetic checker directly compares integrals and formulas in 700 instances, but all-degree scope rests on symbolic proof.

value.rationale: Moving spherical-cap averages are natural rotationally invariant inverse transforms. Their injectivity depends on whether any harmonic multiplier vanishes, and general abstract exceptional-parameter statements do not identify usable apertures. A dense explicitly described family of nonvanishing cutoffs, with a simultaneous all-degree all-even-dimensional arithmetic valuation, is a structural spectral result. The compactness statement records the important distinction between uniqueness and stable recovery. The value is not merely a single numeric valuation or routine parameter increment.
